verdict.rationale: Dagster's evidence describes an MCP server and an AI 'skill' that let external coding agents (e.g. Claude) interact with or build Dagster projects, not a built-in AI assistant embedded inside the Dagster UI/product itself that a user can delegate tasks to. There is no documentation of a native in-product AI assistant/chat feature for task delegation. Missing for 10: any first-party evidence of a built-in AI assistant UI, chat interface, or agentic feature living inside Dagster's own product rather than exposing Dagster to external agents.
